notes.title: Update Notes For Nov 27
notes.content:
[b]Fixed;[/b]

[list]
[*] The problem of money not arriving after a certain time has been resolved.
[*] The problem of inaccessibility of the computer and the door at home has been resolved.
[*] The problem that prevented the acquired workplaces from appearing in the Management Menu has been resolved.
[*] Share panel no longer automatically moves vertically.
[*] Your vehicles no longer crash into each other.
[*] The day cycle has been slowed down.
[*] The problem that prevented the camera from going when you click on the computer has been resolved.
[/list]
